# Routing QC

This document collects a number of quality checks done on the routing results into one place, so they can be easily viewed in one place and re-run on new data. It is separate from the routing methods report, because it contains details of some specific routed trips, and thus distribution must be limited.

This report was rendered with routing results from the following files:

```{python}
#| echo: false
import yaml
import pprint

# quarto always renders in file's working directory
with open("input_files.yml") as fls:
    pprint.pprint(yaml.safe_load(fls))
```
